scope: Independent planning-only architecture and final proposal delta review. No repository edits, builds, tests, native runs, runtime qualification or CPU event-loop investigation.
disposition: Recommend owner review/approval of this pinned r2 architecture and its explicit bounded proof-scope amendment. No remaining blocking proposal findings found. This is advisory independent review, not owner ratification or execution authorization.

resolved_findings.finding: prepare must distinguish native exposure from unchanged content.
resolved_findings.resolution: FrameRequest explicitly carries exposure/content demand and host/device/configuration/attempt identity; coordinator remains delivery owner.

resolved_findings.finding: Typed Interaction labels cannot themselves authorize prefix reuse, especially tool previews.
resolved_findings.resolution: Tags explicitly remain hints subordinate to source/descriptor versions; only audited suffix-only preview changes qualify.

resolved_findings.finding: Ownership migration must not duplicate immutable world payloads or erase later terminal damage.
resolved_findings.resolution: Per-host sessions share charged document handles; terminal snapshot/damage lease covers later encode/acquire/present failure and merges newer damage.

resolved_findings.finding: Offscreen completion must not publish native displayed geometry or acknowledge native damage.
resolved_findings.resolution: Capture uses its own target token and explicitly excludes native hit/damage publication.

resolved_findings.finding: Experiment stopping thresholds should be concrete while duty remains unavailable.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit p95>4ms/p99>8ms stop, no replacement runs; incomplete DRM and no S4 qualification retained.

architecture_review: Concrete retirement of nullable prepared-state policy, direct mutators, duplicate preparation entrypoints and legacy raw/composed world recipes establishes shared ownership beyond an image-cache patch. Existing NativeFrameCoordinator, NativeRenderTarget, SurfaceTransaction, QueueOwner, command bundles, text/terminal and dialog rendering retain their legitimate roles. Retained-history relocation preserves existing algorithms/accounting instead of speculative redesign. Full8x prefix copy remains a coherent sample-preserving candidate; exact GPU output and performance remain unproven.
method_review: Known fd-lifecycle/drain/reset observation gap blocks complete duty qualification, not source planning or the distinct value of an owner-approved own-queue timestamp experiment. R2 explicitly requests the amendment to r1, retains unavailable-duty labels and final requirements, and does not select/ratify ptrace or another unknown observer. Observer mechanism/privilege/race/drain/overhead selection needs a reviewed execution packet before instrumentation execution.
remaining_risks: Implementation must actually retire bypasses across every native/capture consumer; a wrapper retaining parallel mutable authorities does not satisfy the proposal.
Fullcopy bandwidth, cold/camera overhead, device usage support and exact sample output need future authorized proof.
Complete workload-fd observer feasibility and sufficiently low overhead remain unresolved; no implementation mechanism is approved by this review.
Source-health extractions and broad API adoption may be substantial; preserve boundaries rather than opportunistically migrate editor semantic state or CPU scheduling.
evidence_reuse: Prior source inspection and pinned r1 native-wgpu evidence reused at unchanged scope; final r2 delta inspected without repeating runtime work. Earlier independent architecture notes: /tmp/gpu-shared-foundation-independent-review.md.
